verdict.rationale: The docs give a short install-then-init path: `npm install -g ultrametric@0.4.1`, then `ultrametric init`, which previews changes and then writes the skill files. Hands-on probes confirm the CLI installs and runs keylessly via npx, and that `init --dry-run` previews SKILL.md for both Codex and Claude Code targets with exit 0 and no login, so a fast path to an installed skill is credible. Missing for 10: a dedicated quickstart page or any timing evidence for the under-five-minutes claim, a hands-on record of the actual (non-dry-run) skill write, and proof the skill is 'working' without the login and human device-code approval that hosted process retrieval requires.
